title: Customer Support Specialist (Americas)
description:
We are hiring a support specialist to own first-line conversations for our SMB customers.
Headquarters: Remote - USA
You will answer tickets in Zendesk, write help-centre articles, and work with the product team on escalations.
Requirements: 2+ years in customer support or customer service, excellent written communication, comfortable with ticketing systems and SLAs.
This role is open to candidates authorised to work in the United States.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sahili Cloud builds billing infrastructure for African fintechs. We are looking for an SDR to run outbound prospecting into East African startups.
Day to day: build lists, run cold outreach over email and LinkedIn, book demos, keep HubSpot clean, and work closely with the founder on messaging.
Requirements: 1+ year in sales or business development, strong written communication, comfort with CRM hygiene and lead generation. Swahili and English required.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
description:
Tidepool is a small distributed team building climate-risk dashboards. We are hiring a junior frontend developer to work on our React and TypeScript app.
You will build accessible UI components, wire them to our REST API, write tests with Vitest, and pair with a senior engineer weekly.
Requirements: strong JavaScript and TypeScript, React experience, comfort with Git and code review. Bonus: Tailwind, Next.js, data visualisation.
We hire worldwide and pay in USD.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We need a technical support engineer to debug customer integrations with our API and SDKs.
You will reproduce issues, read logs, write SQL queries against customer workspaces, and escalate genuine bugs to engineering with clear reproduction steps.
Requirements: 2+ years technical support or QA, comfort with REST APIs, HTTP, JSON and basic SQL, excellent written English. Python or Node.js scripting a plus.
Candidates must be based in EMEA; some roles still require EU work authorisation.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Bright Metric helps retailers understand footfall. We are hiring a data analyst to own weekly reporting and dashboarding.
You will write SQL against our warehouse, maintain Looker dashboards, run a/b testing readouts, and partner with the marketing team on product analytics.
Requirements: 3+ years in analytics, advanced SQL, strong statistics fundamentals, Excel or Google Sheets fluency. Python and dbt a plus.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Lumen Health sells scheduling software to clinics. We are hiring a customer success manager to own a book of 30 accounts.
You will run onboarding, track churn risk, drive renewals and upselling, and be the voice of the customer in product reviews.
Requirements: 3+ years in customer success or account management, CRM experience (Salesforce or HubSpot), strong presentation skills.
Please note: this position must be located in the United States or Canada.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
Kito Studio is a design studio working with African consumer brands. We are looking for a marketing intern for six months.
You will help with social media scheduling, write newsletter copy, research influencers, and keep our content calendar tidy.
This is an entry-level internship: no experience required, students welcome. You need curiosity, good written English and about 15 hours a week.
Stipend paid monthly.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Platform
description:
Orbital Freight moves containers across three continents. We are hiring a senior staff engineer to lead our platform team.
You will set technical direction for a Kubernetes-based platform, mentor six engineers, own reliability targets, and drive our move to event-driven services with Kafka.
Requirements: 8+ years building distributed systems, deep Go or Rust, strong Kubernetes and Terraform, experience with observability and incident response.

title: Associate Director, Sales
description:
Meridian Pay is expanding its enterprise sales team. As Associate Director of Sales you will manage a team of five account executives, own the forecast, and close strategic deals.
Requirements: 7+ years in B2B sales, 3+ years managing quota-carrying reps, strong negotiation and forecasting skills, Salesforce reporting discipline.
You will report to the VP of Sales and travel twice a quarter.

title: Student Success Manager
description:
Elimu Online runs a learning platform for secondary schools in East Africa. We are looking for a student success manager to support learners and teachers.
You will run onboarding calls, answer support tickets, track engagement, and turn feedback into product ideas.
Requirements: experience in customer support or teaching, excellent communication in English and Swahili, comfort with spreadsheets and a CRM.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js, PostgreSQL)
description:
Pesa Rail builds payment rails for cross-border trade. We are hiring a backend engineer to own our ledger services.
You will design PostgreSQL schemas, build Node.js and TypeScript services, write integration tests, and keep our REST APIs well documented.
Requirements: 3+ years backend development, strong SQL and PostgreSQL, experience with Docker and CI/CD, comfortable working async across three timezones.
We are an equal-opportunity employer hiring across Africa.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Prairie Books, a bookkeeping firm in the Midwest, needs a virtual assistant to manage inbox, scheduling and invoicing for nine clients.
You will handle email correspondence, book travel, maintain spreadsheets, and keep the calendar tidy.
Requirements: excellent written English, attention to detail, comfort with Google Workspace. Two years of administrative experience preferred. 20 hours a week.

title: Content Writer, Developer Tools
description:
Schema Labs makes a database migration tool. We are hiring a content writer who can explain technical ideas clearly.
You will write tutorials, documentation, and a weekly newsletter; interview engineers; and turn support tickets into how-to articles.
Requirements: 2+ years technical writing or content marketing, comfort reading code samples, strong SEO instincts. Experience with Git and Markdown required. Published portfolio expected.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Fieldnote builds offline-first survey tools for NGOs. We need a QA engineer to own release quality.
You will write test plans, maintain Playwright end-to-end tests, triage bugs, and pair with developers on acceptance criteria.
Requirements: 2+ years in QA or test automation, attention to detail, experience with Playwright or Cypress, comfort with Git. Remote worldwide, 4-day week.

title: Bookkeeper (Remote, Kenya preferred)
description:
Tally Partners provides bookkeeping to SMEs across East Africa. We are hiring a bookkeeper.
You will reconcile accounts, run month-end close, chase invoices, prepare payroll, and keep clients compliant with KRA filings.
Requirements: 3+ years bookkeeping or accounting, comfort with QuickBooks and Excel, IFRS basics, excellent communication. CPA part-qualified is a plus.

title: Product Designer
description:
Kite Health is redesigning how clinics book appointments. We are hiring a product designer to own end-to-end flows.
You will run user research, prototype in Figma, maintain our design systems, and test accessibility with real users.
Requirements: 3+ years product design, a strong Figma portfolio, experience with usability testing and design thinking. Front-end familiarity (HTML, CSS) helpful.

title: Community Manager
description:
Open Source Africa supports maintainers across the continent. We are hiring a community manager.
You will run our Slack and Discord, organise monthly virtual events, write the newsletter, and support contributors through their first pull request.
Requirements: 2+ years community management or event planning, excellent written communication, comfort with GitHub and async work. Public speaking experience welcome.

title: Operations Associate
description:
Karoo Logistics coordinates road freight across Southern Africa. We are hiring an operations associate in our Cape Town office.
You will schedule deliveries, manage driver rosters, keep inventory records accurate, and chase exceptions with customers.
Requirements: 2+ years in operations or logistics, strong Excel, process improvement mindset, driver's licence.
This role is Cape Town based; applicants must have the right to work in South Africa.
